items.title: Intention (niyyah)
items.description: Make a sincere intention in your heart to perform wudu for the sake of Allah.

items.title: Say Bismillah
items.description: Begin by saying: Bismillah (In the name of Allah).

items.title: Wash hands & mouth
items.description: Wash both hands three times, rinse the mouth three times, and sniff water into the nose and blow it out three times.

items.title: Wash face & arms
items.description: Wash the entire face three times, then the right arm to the elbow three times, then the left arm.

items.title: Wipe head & wash feet
items.description: Wipe the head once, wipe the ears, and wash the right foot then the left foot up to the ankles three times each.

items.title: Preparation
items.description: Ensure you have wudu, dress modestly, and face the Qibla on a clean prayer space.

items.title: Takbir & standing
items.description: Raise your hands and say Allahu Akbar to begin. Stand with humility and focus.

items.title: Recite Al-Fatiha
items.description: Recite Surah Al-Fatiha in every rak'ah, followed by a short surah or verses in the first two rak'ahs of Fard prayers where applicable.

items.title: Ruku & Sujud
items.description: Bow saying Subhana Rabbiyal Adheem, then prostrate saying Subhana Rabbiyal A'la with calmness and stillness.

items.title: Tashahhud & Salam
items.description: Sit for the final tashahhud, send salawat upon the Prophet ﷺ, then end by turning right and left with salam.

items.title: Intention
items.description: Intend in your heart to perform ghusl to remove major impurity for the sake of Allah.

items.title: Wash hands & private area
items.description: Wash both hands, then wash any impurity from the body.

items.title: Perform wudu
items.description: Complete wudu as you normally would before the final washing of the body.

items.title: Pour water over the body
items.description: Pour water over the head three times, ensuring it reaches the roots of the hair.

items.title: Complete full-body wash
items.description: Wash the entire body, beginning with the right side, making sure no dry spot remains.

items.title: When permitted
items.description: Tayammum is allowed when water is unavailable, harmful to use, or cannot be reached in time for prayer.

items.title: Intention & strike the earth
items.description: Make intention, then strike clean earth once with both palms.

items.title: Wipe the face
items.description: Wipe the entire face once with both hands.

items.title: Wipe the arms
items.description: Wipe the right arm up to the elbow with the left hand, then the left arm with the right hand.

items.title: Purpose
items.description: The Janazah prayer is a communal obligation to seek mercy and forgiveness for the deceased Muslim.

items.title: Stand in rows
items.description: Stand facing the Qibla without ruku or sujud. The body is placed in front of the imam.

items.title: Four takbirs
items.description: Say Allahu Akbar four times. After the first, recite Al-Fatiha silently; after others, send salawat and make du'a for the deceased.

items.title: Make du'a
items.description: Ask Allah to forgive the deceased, grant them steadfastness, and replace their home with a better one in Paradise.

items.title: Finish
items.description: After the final takbir, give salam once to the right as in regular prayer.

items.title: Ihram
items.description: Enter ihram at the miqat with intention for Umrah, avoiding the prohibitions of ihram.

items.title: Tawaf
items.description: Circumambulate the Ka'bah seven times, beginning and ending at the Black Stone if possible, with du'a and dhikr.

items.title: Two rak'ahs
items.description: Pray two rak'ahs behind Maqam Ibrahim if possible.

items.title: Sa'i
items.description: Walk seven times between Safa and Marwah, remembering the trust of Hajar (AS) in Allah.

items.title: Shaving or trimming
items.description: Men shave or trim the hair; women cut a fingertip-length from their hair to complete Umrah.

items.title: Days of Hajj
items.description: Hajj occurs in Dhul Hijjah. Key rites include ihram, standing at Arafah, Muzdalifah, and stoning the Jamarat.

items.title: Tawaf al-Ifadah
items.description: Perform tawaf around the Ka'bah after the day of Arafah as a pillar of Hajj.

items.title: Sa'i of Hajj
items.description: Complete sa'i between Safa and Marwah if not already done in Umrah.

items.title: Stay at Mina
items.description: Spend nights at Mina and stone the Jamarat on the days of tashriq with patience and dhikr.

items.title: Farewell Tawaf
items.description: Before leaving Makkah, perform the farewell tawaf (Tawaf al-Wada') as the final rite.

items.title: Intention
items.description: Intend to fast each day of Ramadan from before Fajr for the sake of Allah.

items.title: Suhoor
items.description: Eat a pre-dawn meal (suhoor)—there is blessing in it—even if it is small.

items.title: Avoid invalidators
items.description: Refrain from food, drink, and intimacy from Fajr until Maghrib. Guard the tongue and actions.

items.title: Iftar with gratitude
items.description: Break the fast at Maghrib with dates and water if available, saying the du'a of the fasting person.

items.title: Night worship
items.description: Increase Quran, du'a, and optional prayers in Ramadan, especially in the last ten nights.

items.title: Who must pay
items.description: Zakat is due on qualifying wealth held for one lunar year when it reaches the nisab threshold.

items.title: Rate
items.description: The common rate on cash, gold, and silver is 2.5% of qualifying surplus wealth.

items.title: Eligible recipients
items.description: Give to the eight categories mentioned in the Quran, prioritizing local need where possible.

items.title: Intention & timing
items.description: Make intention that the payment is zakat. It may be paid anytime after it becomes due, many pay in Ramadan.

items.title: Impact
items.description: Zakat purifies wealth, reduces greed, and strengthens the community's most vulnerable members.

items.title: Stop the sin
items.description: Sincere repentance begins with immediately leaving the sin and resolving not to return to it.

items.title: Regret
items.description: Feel genuine remorse in the heart for disobeying Allah.

items.title: Resolve not to repeat
items.description: Make a firm intention to avoid the sin going forward, and change conditions that lead to it.

items.title: Seek forgiveness
items.description: Say Astaghfirullah, make du'a, and if the sin involved others' rights, restore those rights.

items.title: Allah's mercy
items.description: Allah loves those who repent. No sin is too great if repentance is sincere and before death.
